wire.slash.notifications_page.help.role: command description line in /help, the completion picker and the desktop command palette
wire.slash.notifications_page.help.note: The /notifications command: opens the Notifications page (open asks waiting on the operator plus updates agents posted with notify). `read` is a typed word the command reads, keep it verbatim. Never call the page an 'Inbox' in product copy. English-only child namespace, kept out of the audited wire.slash catalogue so its locale hashes do not move.
